title: Chapter 48 — The Trade Desk: Setting Up Your B2B Operation
intro: The operational architecture — running trade inside a retail floor.

sections.title: Separate but Connected
sections.content:
The trade desk should operate with its own processes, pricing structures, and service standards — but within the same store. Trade orders have different timelines, different margins, and different service requirements than retail.

Managing both effectively requires clear boundaries, separate tracking, and a team that understands the difference.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating trade desk operations, ask:

Is the trade desk operating with clear processes and pricing — or ad hoc?
Are trade orders tracked separately from retail?
Does the team understand the different service standards trade requires?
